info.name: Restoring the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture

descriptions.inProgress: Alcaster says he has everything set to restore the sculpture, and gives me an Ice Crystal. He says that a magic spell is cast onto this crystal, and will help restore the sculpture.\n\n#i4031791##t4031791#  #b#c4031791#/1
descriptions.completed: The snowman seems to have returned to its gentle self as soon as the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture was restored. No worries about the Snowman attacking anyone else, right?
